recommendation_title: Prioritize Billing: Fix Premium-Only Controls Next Quarter
recommendation: The top-ranked issue, ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS, leads all issues with 58,940 complaints [C001] and a severity sum of 174,087 [C002], well ahead of the next issue's 147,625 [C008]. This is a free-tier packaging and pricing decision about which playback controls (song choice, skips, rewind, order, lyrics) are allowed without Premium, not a payment-processing or support failure, so the fix is product work on the free-tier experience rather than billing operations. Representative complaints describe being unable to choose or skip tracks, e.g. `8964aaea-f4c7-4b01-94e0-a76b992018fd` and `2d1b5fa6-5d80-4616-9b65-f6e7738e9edf`, confirming the pattern behind the numbers.

alternatives.title: Usability (ads, redesign, library/queue)
alternatives.why_not_first: Usability's top issue, ads (ISS-USABILITY-ADS), has a lower severity sum of 85,318 [C012] than the billing issue's 174,087 [C002], and area-level severity_sum for usability (178,198) trails billing_support's 204,819 in the area table.

alternatives.title: Playback (stops/skips, crashes)
alternatives.why_not_first: Playback's top issue, stops/skips, carries a severity sum of only 44,042 [C016], far below the billing issue's 174,087 [C002], despite playback having high mean severity per complaint.

alternatives.title: Access (login failures)
alternatives.why_not_first: Access's top issue has the fewest complaints at 8,029 [C025] and a severity sum of 31,314 [C028], the smallest among all ranked issues, so it affects far fewer reported cases than billing.

alternatives.title: General app dissatisfaction (other/none)
alternatives.why_not_first: ISS-OTHER-GENERAL ranks second with 147,625 severity sum [C008], but per issue_definitions it covers general praise, generic criticism, unrelated or unclear text, so it is not actionable as a specific product fix.
